days.title: Journey, Check-in, Rest, Sunset at Raja's Seat & Temple Darshan
days.summary: Depart home at 5:45 AM, board the KSRTC EV Power Plus from Kengeri TTMC with an en route highway breakfast break, and arrive in Madikeri by 1:00 PM. Check in at Treebo Doha King, enjoy a pure vegetarian lunch at Udupi The Veg, book Saturday's 4x4 jeep safari, and take a 1.5-hour afternoon rest. Head to Raja's Seat for daylight views, golden hour, and sunset, followed by an illuminated evening visit to Shri Omkareshwara Swamy Temple and a relaxed vegetarian dinner.
checklist: Book an auto from JDR Aadhitri by 05:35 AM to reach Kengeri TTMC by 05:55 AM
Keep KSRTC PNR (KS22879177) and Government IDs ready for conductor verification
Inspect room linens and geyser at Treebo Doha King before heading to lunch
Lock in the 4x4 jeep at the taxi stand next to the bus stand during lunch for the Saturday 06:00 AM Mandalpatti pickup
Carry a light windbreaker or umbrella for cool evening breeze and mist at Raja's Seat
Keep physical cash handy for local Madikeri auto rides (₹50 per trip)

timeline.title: Auto from Home to Kengeri TTMC
timeline.description: Leave from Home by auto (approx. 2.8 km, 10–12 min drive) to reach Kengeri BMTC TTMC bus bay by 05:55 AM, giving a comfortable 25-minute buffer before departure.

timeline.title: Board KSRTC EV Power Plus
timeline.description: Board KSRTC EV Power Plus from Kengeri TTMC platform. Enjoy a smooth cruise along the Bengaluru–Mysuru Expressway.

timeline.title: En Route Highway Breakfast Stop
timeline.description: Bus halts for a scheduled 25–30 minute breakfast break at a pure veg highway food plaza along the expressway / bypass (Maddur/Mandya stretch). Enjoy hot thatte idli, vada, masala dosa, and filter coffee.

timeline.title: Scenic Ghat Journey to Madikeri
timeline.description: Resume the journey cruising past Mysuru, Hunsur, and Kushalnagar, ascending through the lush Western Ghats into Kodagu district.

timeline.title: Arrival at Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand
timeline.description: Alight at Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand. Collect luggage, stretch legs, and exit towards the rear gate heading towards the hotel.

timeline.title: Walk to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Take a short 2-minute stroll (approx. 200–300 meters) directly behind the bus stand to reach Treebo Doha King.
timeline.location: Madikeri Bus Stand to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Check-in & Freshen Up at Hotel
timeline.description: Complete check-in formalities at the front desk, inspect room linens and geyser, drop luggage, and quickly freshen up before lunch.

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Take a short 2-minute stroll (approx. 150 meters) from Treebo Doha King towards Udupi The Veg near the bus stand entrance.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy a hot, freshly prepared South Indian lunch (akki roti with saagu, neer dosa, or South Indian meals thali) along with hot filter coffee.

timeline.title: Walk to Madikeri Taxi & Jeep Stand
timeline.description: Step outside the restaurant and take a 1-minute walk to the main Madikeri Taxi & 4x4 Jeep Stand adjacent to the KSRTC Bus Station.
timeline.location: Madikeri Jeep Stand (Near KSRTC Bus Stand)

timeline.title: Book 4x4 Jeep Safari for Day 2
timeline.description: Coordinate directly with local drivers at the jeep stand. Lock in Saturday's 06:00 AM hotel pickup for Mandalpatti Peak (sunrise/morning clouds) + Abbey Falls circuit (target ₹2,200–₹2,500 total). Exchange mobile numbers and reconfirm pickup spot at Treebo Doha King.

timeline.title: Walk back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Walk 3 minutes (approx. 250 meters) back to Treebo Doha King from the jeep stand.
timeline.location: Jeep Stand to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Midday Rest & Refresh at Hotel
timeline.description: Relax in the room for an uninterrupted 1.5-hour afternoon rest to recharge from the early-morning start and 6-hour road journey.

timeline.title: Auto to Raja's Seat
timeline.description: Hire an auto from outside the hotel / bus stand area up to the entrance of Raja's Seat viewpoint.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Raja's Seat

timeline.title: Raja's Seat Gardens, Sunset & Viewpoint
timeline.description: Purchase entry tickets (₹25–₹40 per person). Stroll through the seasonal flower beds, enjoy expansive daylight panoramic views of Coorg's misty hills and valleys, catch golden hour and sunset over the Western Ghats around 06:05–06:15 PM.

timeline.title: Auto from Raja's Seat to Shri Omkareshwara Temple
timeline.description: Take a local auto from Raja's Seat parking down into town to Shri Omkareshwara Swamy Temple.

timeline.title: Omkareshwara Temple Darshan & Sacred Tank Stroll
timeline.description: Leave footwear at the counter, enter the temple for evening aarti, admire the unique Islamic dome and Gothic minaret architecture, and enjoy a quiet walk around the central fish tank lit by evening lamps.

timeline.title: Auto from Temple to Bus Stand / Hotel Area
timeline.description: Take a return auto from the temple stand back to the central bus stand area near the hotel.

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Short 2-minute stroll across to Udupi The Veg for dinner.
timeline.location: Bus Stand Area to Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Dinner at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy a comforting pure vegetarian dinner (crispy dosas, bisibelebath, or South Indian meals) without any rush.

timeline.title: Walk back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes back to Treebo Doha King. Collect extra water bottles, ensure warm layers and windbreakers are packed for the open-top morning jeep ride, and wind down for early rest.
timeline.location: Udupi The Veg to Treebo Doha King

days.title: 4x4 Jeep Safari, Abbey Falls, Fort, Temples, Royal Tombs & Specialty Coffee
days.summary: Embark on an early-morning 4x4 off-road jeep safari to Mandalpatti Peak and Abbey Falls, returning to Madikeri by 1:00 PM with a built-in traffic buffer. After a pure vegetarian lunch and a quick 45-minute refresh at Treebo Doha King, explore Madikeri Fort & Museum, take darshan at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple, tour the royal mausoleums at Gaddige, and enjoy an evening specialty brew tasting at Ainmane Coffee before an early dinner.
checklist: Wear warm windcheaters or jackets for the breezy open 4x4 jeep safari
Wear sturdy walking shoes with good traction for wet rocky pathways around Abbey Falls
Carry ₹2,500 - ₹3,000 cash for the private 4x4 jeep driver, entry tickets, and forest eco-tax
Keep physical cash handy for afternoon auto rides to Fort, Gaddige, and Ainmane (₹50-₹70 per trip)

timeline.title: Early Wakeup & Hot Coffee
timeline.description: Wake up to brisk mountain air at Treebo Doha King, make hot tea/coffee in room, gear up in warm layers and windbreakers, and prep water bottles for the bumpy trail.

timeline.title: Board 4x4 Jeep to Mandalpatti Peak
timeline.description: Meet driver at hotel porch. Board the 4x4 jeep and head north out of Madikeri town into the winding hills, passing coffee estates before hitting the rugged off-road forest department track.

timeline.title: Mandalpatti Peak Summit & Cloud Views
timeline.description: Arrive at Mandalpatti parking. Pay Forest entry/eco-fee, take the short 10-min uphill walk to the viewpoint tower. Take in the 360-degree panoramic vista over Pushpagiri sanctuary shrouded in morning clouds.

timeline.title: Scenic Jeep Descent to Abbey Falls Junction
timeline.description: Board jeep from summit parking and descend down the rocky trail, cutting across lush green interior estate lanes towards Abbey Falls.

timeline.title: Hot Breakfast & Filter Coffee near Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Take a 25-minute stop at the tea shacks near Abbey Falls entrance for hot thatte idlis / vada, piping hot Coorg filter coffee, and fresh tender coconut before walking down the steps.

timeline.title: Abbey Falls Exploration & Hanging Bridge
timeline.description: Purchase entry tickets, walk down the paved stone steps (approx. 200 steps) through coffee and spice plantations. Photograph the roaring monsoon-fed cascade from the suspension footbridge.

timeline.title: Jeep Return to Hotel (with Traffic Buffer)
timeline.description: Climb up to the jeep parking and drive back to Madikeri. A generous 1 hour 30 minute buffer handles any tourist traffic along the narrow approach road, reaching Treebo Doha King comfortably by 12:45 PM – 01:00 PM.
timeline.location: Abbey Falls to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Drop at Hotel
timeline.description: Alight at Treebo Doha King, verify full circuit completion, and settle agreed jeep hiring fare with the driver.

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Take the short 2-minute stroll across to Udupi The Veg for lunch.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Relish a hearty South Indian lunch (meals thali, akki roti with veg saagu, or neer dosa) to refuel after the active morning.

timeline.title: Walk back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Short 2-minute stroll back to the hotel.
timeline.location: Udupi The Veg to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Shower, Refresh & Rest at Hotel
timeline.description: Shower to wash off trail red dust, change into light afternoon clothing, recharge mobile phones/cameras, and relax in the room.

timeline.title: Auto to Madikeri Fort
timeline.description: Hire an auto outside the hotel / bus stand to Madikeri Fort entrance (approx. 1.2 km, 5–7 mins).
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Explore Madikeri Fort & Government Museum
timeline.description: Walk the 17th-century stone ramparts, view the life-sized stone elephants, and tour the state archaeological museum housed inside the Gothic St. Mark's Church.

timeline.title: Darshan at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple
timeline.description: Walk directly across the fort gateway courtyard to Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple for prayers and blessings at this revered historical shrine.
timeline.location: Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple, Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Auto to Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Hire an auto from the fort gate up through Mahadevpet to Gaddige (approx. 2.2 km).

timeline.title: Tour Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Explore the 18th-century royal Indo-Saracenic domed monuments of King Lingarajendra II and Doddaveerarajendra set amidst green lawns.

timeline.title: Auto to Ainmane Coffee Experience Centre
timeline.description: Take an auto from Gaddige down to Ainmane on College Road (approx. 2.5 km).

timeline.title: Specialty Coffee Tasting at Ainmane
timeline.description: Sip artisanal single-origin estate brews (such as Monsooned Malabar), try passion fruit spreads, and explore local chocolate gifts in a cozy ambiance.

timeline.title: Relaxed Town Stroll
timeline.description: Stroll down College Road towards the central market to see Dasara festive lights, spice shop displays, and evening street vibe.

timeline.title: Walk to Pure Veg Dinner
timeline.description: Take a short walk towards Udupi The Veg or Atithi Restaurant for dinner.

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Dinner
timeline.description: Enjoy a warm South Indian dinner (ghee roast dosa, bisibelebath, or meals) without any rush.

timeline.title: Walk back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Take a 2-minute stroll back to Treebo Doha King. Start packing main luggage leisurely for Sunday morning checkout.

additionalBudget.title: Forest Department Mandalpatti Entry & Eco Tax

timeline.title: Warm Hotel Breakfast & Filter Coffee
timeline.description: Wake up at a leisurely pace, check outside weather conditions, and enjoy a warm, fresh South Indian breakfast (idli, vada, dosa, and hot filter coffee) at Treebo Doha King or Udupi The Veg to wait out morning rains.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King / Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Arrange Covered Cab to Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Coordinate with hotel reception or the taxi stand directly behind the hotel for a closed, covered hatchback/sedan cab for a round-trip to Abbey Falls (avoids rain and open winds).

timeline.title: Covered Cab Drive to Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Board the covered cab and take a scenic, mist-covered 8 km drive through lush, rain-washed coffee and spice plantations.

timeline.title: Abbey Falls Exploration & Hanging Bridge
timeline.description: Equipped with umbrellas/rainwear, buy entry tickets and descend the paved steps through dense foliage. View the roaring monsoon cascade safely from the sheltered viewpoints and suspension bridge.

timeline.title: Hot Coorg Tea & Snacks Break
timeline.description: Warm up with piping hot ginger tea, filter coffee, and freshly steamed sweet corn or bajji at the covered stalls near Abbey Falls entrance.

timeline.title: Covered Cab Return to Madikeri Town
timeline.description: Board the waiting cab for a smooth return drive to Madikeri town, safely dropping back at Treebo Doha King before peak noon traffic.
timeline.location: Abbey Falls to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Pre-Lunch Hotel Rest & Unwind
timeline.description: Dry off, change out of damp rain jackets/shoes, and unwind comfortably in the hotel room.

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Take the short 2-minute stroll across to Udupi The Veg for lunch.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy a comforting, hot vegetarian lunch (akki roti with saagu, South Indian meals thali, or hot rasam rice).

timeline.title: Walk back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Short 2-minute stroll back to the hotel room.
timeline.location: Udupi The Veg to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Afternoon Rest & Refresh
timeline.description: Recharge in the room before beginning the sheltered town sightseeing circuit.

timeline.title: Auto to Madikeri Fort
timeline.description: Take a 5-minute auto ride from the hotel/bus stand area up to the fort gates (approx. 1.2 km).
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Explore Madikeri Fort & Government Museum
timeline.description: Tour the sheltered exhibits inside the Gothic St. Mark's Church archaeological museum (sculptures, historical coins, weaponry) and photograph the fort ramparts.

timeline.title: Darshan at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple
timeline.description: Walk directly across the sheltered courtyard right at the fort gate for prayers and blessings at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple.
timeline.location: Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple, Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Auto to Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Hire an auto outside the fort gate heading north up to Gaddige (approx. 2.2 km).

timeline.title: Tour Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: View the royal Indo-Saracenic domed mausoleums, admire the intricate stone carvings, and stroll the quiet grounds.

timeline.title: Auto to Ainmane Coffee Experience Centre
timeline.description: Take an auto from Gaddige down to Ainmane on College Road (approx. 2.5 km).

timeline.title: Specialty Coffee Tasting at Ainmane
timeline.description: Warm up inside the cozy cafe with hot artisanal estate brews, homemade pastries, and local chocolate shopping while watching rain over the hills.

timeline.title: Relaxed Town Stroll / Covered Arcade Walk
timeline.description: Take an easy umbrella walk through town along covered shop corridors, enjoying the evening vibe.

timeline.title: Walk to Pure Veg Dinner
timeline.description: Short walk towards Udupi The Veg or Atithi Restaurant for dinner.

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Dinner
timeline.description: Enjoy a hot, satisfying South Indian dinner (dosa, bisibelebath, or hot meals).

timeline.title: Walk back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Stroll 2 minutes back to Treebo Doha King. Pack luggage leisurely for checkout tomorrow morning.

days.title: Military Heritage, Checkout, Spice Shopping & Return Bus
days.summary: Start Sunday with a fresh South Indian breakfast and an early morning tour of the General Thimayya Memorial Museum ('Sunny Side') to view the MiG-21 and military artifacts. Complete checkout at Treebo Doha King before 11:00 AM, store bags at the front desk, and enjoy dedicated, hands-free spice and chocolate shopping in the town bazaar. After an early pure veg lunch at Udupi The Veg, collect luggage and walk across to Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand to board the 01:30 PM Airavat Club Class bus back to Bengaluru.
checklist: Complete room packing and front desk checkout at Treebo Doha King by 10:45 AM
Hand over luggage to hotel reception for safe cloakroom storage during shopping and lunch
Keep KSRTC return PNR (KS22879259) and government IDs accessible on phone
Purchase whole black pepper, green cardamom, Coorg honey, and fresh filter coffee powder during the bazaar walk
Ensure you reach Platform 0 at Madikeri Bus Stand by 01:10 PM for the 01:30 PM Airavat departure

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Step out from Treebo Doha King and take a 2-minute stroll (150 meters) across to Udupi The Veg.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Pure Veg Breakfast & Filter Coffee
timeline.description: Enjoy a fresh, piping-hot South Indian breakfast (thatte idli-vada, crisp masala dosa, and traditional filter coffee) to kickstart the final day.

timeline.title: Walk to Auto Stand & Board Auto
timeline.description: Walk 1 minute to the auto stand outside the bus station and hire an auto heading north to 'Sunny Side' (General Thimayya Museum).
timeline.location: Madikeri Auto Stand to General Thimayya Memorial Museum

timeline.title: Tour General Thimayya Memorial Museum (Sunny Side)
timeline.description: Explore the ancestral home of former Chief of Army Staff General K.S. Thimayya right at opening time. Inspect the decommissioned IAF MiG-21 fighter jet, the Indian Army T-55 battle tank, military artillery, medals, and historical war galleries.

timeline.title: Auto from Museum back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Hire an auto outside the museum gates for the short return drive down to Treebo Doha King (approx. 1.2 km).
timeline.location: General Thimayya Memorial Museum to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Final Packing, Checkout & Cloakroom Luggage Drop
timeline.description: Conduct a final sweep of the room for chargers, toiletries, and jackets. Complete official checkout at Treebo Doha King reception before 11:00 AM, and deposit main travel bags with the front desk cloakroom for hands-free afternoon shopping.

timeline.title: Hands-Free Spice, Coffee & Chocolate Shopping
timeline.description: Stroll hands-free through Madikeri central bazaar (College Road and market area). Shop at established outlets like Coorg Greens, Choci Coorg, or Big Cup Cafe store for GI-tagged whole black pepper, green cardamom pods, pure wild honey, artisan fruit chocolates, and fresh estate-ground filter coffee powder.

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Walk back from the bazaar area across to Udupi The Veg near the bus terminal.

timeline.title: Early Pure Veg Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy an unhurried, nourishing pure vegetarian South Indian thali or lunch before boarding the long-distance return bus.

timeline.title: Retrieve Luggage from Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes back into Treebo Doha King, show your cloakroom token to collect stored bags, use the restroom, and ensure bus tickets/water bottles are accessible.

timeline.title: Walk to Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand
timeline.description: Take the flat 2-minute stroll (approx. 200 meters) from the hotel rear exit directly into Platform 0 of Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand. Identify your Airavat Club Class bus (Trip Code: 1002MNGBNG).
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to KSRTC Bus Stand Platform 0

timeline.title: Luggage Loading & Boarding Airavat Club Class
timeline.description: Load larger backpacks into the undercarriage luggage bay, show digital ticket (PNR: KS22879259, Seats: 5, 6) to the conductor, and settle into recliner seats before departure.

timeline.title: Depart Madikeri: Scenic Ghat Descent
timeline.description: Bus departs on schedule. Relax through the winding Western Ghat descent via Suntikoppa, Kushalnagar, and Piriyapatna towards Hunsur bypass.

timeline.title: En Route Highway Tea & Restroom Halt
timeline.description: Scheduled 20–25 minute KSRTC refreshment halt at an expressway food plaza (around Mandya / Maddur stretch). Grab hot tea/filter coffee, snacks, and stretch legs.

timeline.title: Expressway Cruise to Bengaluru (with Traffic Buffer)
timeline.description: Resume high-speed cruise along Bengaluru–Mysuru Expressway with built-in buffer for Sunday evening entry traffic heading into Kengeri.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri BMTC TTMC
timeline.description: Alight at Kengeri BMTC TTMC flyover bus bay. Collect baggage from the luggage hold and head down the ramp to the auto stand.

timeline.title: Auto from Kengeri TTMC to Home
timeline.description: Hire a local auto from Kengeri TTMC stand back home to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya (approx. 2.8 km, 12–15 mins).
timeline.location: Kengeri TTMC to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Take a 2-minute umbrella stroll across to Udupi The Veg for breakfast.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Udupi The Veg

timeline.title: Relaxed Breakfast at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy a warm South Indian breakfast (thatte idli, vada, masala dosa, and filter coffee) without rushing through early morning showers.

timeline.title: Covered Auto to General Thimayya Museum
timeline.description: Hire an auto directly outside the bus stand to 'Sunny Side' (approx. 1.2 km).
timeline.location: Madikeri Auto Stand to General Thimayya Memorial Museum

timeline.title: Indoor Tour of General Thimayya Museum
timeline.description: Explore the indoor military galleries, medals, war artifacts, and weaponry safely sheltered inside the museum building.

timeline.title: Auto back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Take an auto from the museum back down to Treebo Doha King.
timeline.location: General Thimayya Memorial Museum to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Hotel Checkout & Luggage Drop
timeline.description: Complete room checkout formalities and hand over bags to the front desk reception cloak storage.

timeline.title: Covered Emporium & Spice Shopping
timeline.description: Shop inside covered government and estate spice emporiums along College Road for black pepper, cardamom, local chocolates, and coffee powder, staying dry.

timeline.title: Walk to Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Short walk back towards Udupi The Veg near the bus stand.

timeline.title: Early Pure Veg Lunch
timeline.description: Enjoy a warm South Indian thali, rasam rice, or hot dosa at Udupi The Veg.

timeline.title: Retrieve Luggage from Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Collect stored baggage from hotel reception, prepare rain gear, and freshen up before bus boarding.

timeline.title: Walk to KSRTC Covered Platform 0
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes into the covered bus bay of Platform 0 at Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand.

timeline.title: Luggage Loading & Boarding Airavat Club Class
timeline.description: Load luggage into undercarriage hold and board Airavat Club Class (PNR: KS22879259, Seats: 5, 6).

timeline.title: Depart Madikeri: Western Ghat Descent
timeline.description: Scenic rainy descent via Kushalnagar and Hunsur bypass towards Bengaluru.

timeline.title: Highway Tea & Restroom Halt
timeline.description: Scheduled 20–25 minute KSRTC refreshment halt at an expressway food plaza near Mandya. Grab hot tea/coffee and snacks.

timeline.title: Expressway Cruise to Bengaluru
timeline.description: High-speed expressway run with traffic buffer for Sunday evening arrival into Kengeri.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri BMTC TTMC
timeline.description: Alight at Kengeri BMTC TTMC flyover bus bay, retrieve bags, and head down to the auto stand.

timeline.title: Auto from Kengeri TTMC to Home
timeline.description: Take an auto back home to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya (approx. 2.8 km).
timeline.location: Kengeri TTMC to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya
